question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.
The _____ theory revolutionized the field of anthropology.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. evolutionary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the blank is to be filled with the correct spelling of the word that describes a theory that revolutionized anthropology.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"evolutionary."**
 
• The options provided include incorrect spellings such as:
 
 
• **Option 1:** evoluttionary – incorrect due to double "t."
 
• **Option 3:** evolusionary – incorrect due to "sion" instead of "tion."
 
• **Option 4:** evvoluttionary – incorrect due to double "v" and double "t."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** evolutionary is the correct spelling, making it the right choice.

Correct sentence: *The **evolutionary** theory revolutionized the field of anthropology*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to carefully check spellings in questions involving vocabulary and eliminate options with obvious errors.
 
• Pay attention to common suffixes such as "-tion" or "-sion" in English words.
 
• The word "evolutionary" is derived from "evolution," which refers to gradual development or changes over time, especially in scientific contexts.
